properties.state: {"description":"One served read (a tool, and the same payload where intent is re-injected into a long build) that renders the concept layer of a design in a code-like form: requirements as the rules that must hold; each capability as a function header with its signature (name, inputs, outputs, kind) or an explicit \"unsigned\" marker; Constraints and enforced DesignRules as continuously-obeyed constraints with their units and consequence; every Interface the work crosses as a port, `unspecified` shown as such; components only where they exist. Every line traces to a node id, so a fill-in is detectable; the reply reports its own size and the fraction of capabilities unsigned; a scope (Component, Capability, Project) narrows it the way detect_gaps narrows. Not a persisted document and not a grammar: a projection over the schema that already exists, in the structured natural language language models already read. Planned 2026-09-13.","name":"The pseudo-design layer is served as one compact, code-shaped reference for the implementing agent, derived from the graph on every read and sized for context","provenance":"authored","status":"planned","tier":"operational"}
